* fix(adapter-nextjs): address serve.js review feedback

- boot.ts: check manifest path containment with path.relative, which also
  works when the root is "/" and for paths on other Windows drives, and only
  reject a distDir that is ".." or starts with "../" (not names like
  "..next").

  start from the original request URL, and trim trailing slashes from the
  request path in linear time instead of with a polynomial /\/+$/ regex

- headers.ts: rely on removeHeader being case-insensitive instead of also
  scanning every header name on each response.

  consumers accurately, list the next-routing.json fields that are actually
  emitted, correct the PORT default (3000), and drop the
  CLOUD_RUN_OPTIMIZE_SSR row, which serve.js never read.

* fix(adapter-nextjs): address review feedback on serve.js

  wrapResponseForGuard before rewriting so caller inputs are never mutated,
  and forward the copy to origWriteHead with the original call shape;
  require a positive integer max-age (> 0) on guarded routes so max-age=0
  falls back to NO_STORE_CACHE_CONTROL.

  isValidManifestShape and return false on invalid regex syntax.
